title: Workflow-script-quality standard enforcement registry
description: Shape-only schema for .gitapex/workflow-script-quality.enforcement.toml. The must-have key set (M1-M10) and its enforced/backing referential integrity are owned by scripts/scan_quality_standard_drift.py (the normative validator); the key set is intentionally not duplicated here as an enum so a new must-have needs no schema edit. Refs #1089, #196, #197, #2342.
